headline: SEBI's new circular delights market, investors sell off shares from Groww to Angel One
summary: SEBI said it will review the method for setting settlement prices for futures and options one month after the Closing Auction Session begins. Investors sold shares of brokerages including Groww and Angel One.
why: SEBI is India's securities regulator, and changes to derivatives settlement rules affect trading volumes and revenue at retail brokers.
why_moved: Investors sold brokerage shares after SEBI announced a review of how F&O settlement prices are set, which affects the brokers' derivatives business.
